scope: Independent static review only; patch not applied and no guard tests executed by reviewer
finding: The old fixture binds every reuse to a historical task directory. Proposed patch supplies explicit current task/allocation and binds the exact allocation file bytes/path to the permit.
new_guards: Required relative Trellis task identifier constrained to a single task slug
Permit task and source root still match actual checkout
Permit allocation realpath and SHA256 equal selected allocation
Allocation itself declares matching task and source root
recommendation: Apply only in the test-harness scope after source freeze/update coordination, then exercise the actual exported detailJourneyProvenance with mocked fs/process/network/pg boundaries or task-owned temporary records. Do not test a duplicated predicate implementation. No live services or auth needed for negative contract cases. Run two unchanged product journeys separately only after production provenance is reissued for new harness bytes.

required_cases.case: Valid new task and exact allocation
required_cases.change: Set current task environment; permit.task and allocation.task match; both source_root resolve to candidate; permit allocation path/hash match actual temp allocation bytes; all existing identities valid.
required_cases.expected: Actual detailJourneyProvenance returns current task and reaches existing listener/health/read-only DB validation. No login or mutation is performed by this function.

required_cases.change: Remove task, allocation env, or provenance env separately.
required_cases.expected: Throws before listener, fetch, pg.connect and TestApiClient/login.

required_cases.change: Use absolute task, ../ traversal, nested path, or task string with separator after task slug.
required_cases.expected: Rejects at new task format gate before any live side effects.

required_cases.change: Set allocation env to relative file path.
required_cases.expected: Rejects before reading allocation or fetching services.

required_cases.change: Valid new task env but permit.task is old task; separately set runtime_permitted=false or wrong source_root.
required_cases.expected: Rejects original permit identity gate before allocation/network/DB.

required_cases.change: Permit points at one file; env points at a different resolved file containing identical bytes.
required_cases.expected: Rejects resolved-file binding even though byte hash matches.

required_cases.change: Hash original bytes in permit, then change allocated database or any byte without changing permit hash.
required_cases.expected: Rejects new allocation digest gate before origin, listeners, fetch or DB.

required_cases.change: Update permit hash to the fixture bytes but allocation.task or resolved allocation.source_root belongs to another task/checkout.
required_cases.expected: Rejects allocation ownership; hash correctness alone is insufficient.

required_cases.change: Remove allocation_file or allocation_sha256 from otherwise valid permit; use malformed JSON separately.
required_cases.expected: Fails closed before service calls, without falling back to historic allocation.

required_cases.change: With valid current-task inputs, parameterize wrong allocated endpoint/DB, credentialed or remote origin, changed source/artifact hash, wrong Build ID, different PID, wrong health commit/auth mode, served renderer hash drift, rendered API/WS drift and wrong DB gates.
required_cases.expected: Each actual old guard rejects at its existing boundary; count preceding read-only operations and prove no authentication/mutation occurs.

required_cases.change: Use two symlink aliases to the same actual allocation file, same bytes/hash; then retarget one alias to another file.
required_cases.expected: Same realpath aliases are accepted as designed; different realpath rejects. This checks resolved identity rather than textual path equality.

test_design: Invoke actual exported function; count execFileSync/fetch/pg connect/query/TestApiClient calls. Early new-gate failures must make no listener/network/DB/auth calls.
Full valid case supplies deterministic fixtures for existing listener/HTTP/DB guards and returns current task; no new alternate acceptance path.
Keep original source/artifact/Build ID/listener/HTTP/DB mismatch expectations to detect accidental bypass.
Each test restores process.env and module mocks; mutable files are temporary owned fixture files, never old task evidence or application source.
notes: The patch removes only the hardcoded task and historical allocation location. Existing business-journey assertions and downstream production checks are unchanged.
Allocation/provenance files remain root-produced control inputs; this patch does not cryptographically authenticate their author and does not claim to.
Missing or inconsistent files fail rather than fall back to the historical task. Prior two BLOCKED inventory rows remain blocked until patch plus contract checks and actual journeys pass.
